name: Event
description: A scheduled happening — meeting, interview, trip leg, appointment.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: What it is called: a short label for the event.

attributes.name: about
attributes.description: What the event concerns — the vacancy being interviewed for, the company being talked to, the project being discussed.

attributes.name: descriptions
attributes.description: How this one has been described, in whoever's words — several are normal, because people describe the same thing differently and each telling is worth keeping.

attributes.name: tags
attributes.description: Loose ties to other things, for what no attribute or relation says: everything about the move, everyone from that conference.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: The latest of this one's descriptions, as one string. Writing it adds a description; they all live there.

what_to_say: when it is or was, where, who was in it, and what it was for
brief: something that happens at a time — a meeting, an interview, a trip leg
